A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EulerFlow research despite the changed title. The main text, equations, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Argoverse 2 and Waymo evaluations, ablations, and qualitative tabletop and tracking experiments, including additional results in Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative experiments in Section 5 and Appendix A.

M1.justification: The single neural prior, five-dimensional space-time-direction input, bidirectional three-step reconstruction, and one-step cycle loss weighted by 0.01 are retained. The ODE reformulation and rewritten equations do not establish a changed algorithm; Appendix C preserves the implementation's direction input.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Argoverse 2, Waymo, and the same collected tabletop scenes. The DepthCrafter-based monocular-depth example and bird-tracking scenario already appear in v1; no evaluated dataset, task, or scenario is added.

E2.justification: The corresponding Argoverse 2, Waymo, and qualitative comparisons retain their baseline sets. NSFP and NTP also remain the comparators in the sequence-length and loss ablations; no evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, Dynamic Normalized EPE metric, ego compensation, ground removal, network-depth choices, and ablation settings are retained. Omitted optimizer settings reduce documentation under D1 but do not establish a changed experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The sequence-length, reconstruction/cycle-loss, network-depth, activation-function, and time-encoding ablations are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same monocular-depth example and moving-shadow failure analysis. The new ODE derivation is mathematical exposition, not an additional empirical analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The statistical reporting practice remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched benchmark, per-class, and ablation values are unchanged, as are qualitative findings. For example, EulerFlow's mean Dynamic Normalized EPE remains 0.1304 on Argoverse 2 test and 0.2187 on Waymo validation (v1 Figures 4–5; v3 Figures 5–6).

T1.justification: Section 3 replaces the PDE formulation with an Eulerian velocity-field ODE and specifies initialization at the queried position instead of v1's zero-initial-condition description. New Appendix D defines the trajectory and velocity functions and derives arbitrary-time integration and Euler approximations (Equations 4–17). The added summed formulas use endpoint indices inconsistent with the explicit recurrence in Equation 13.

C1.justification: The central contribution is redefined from Scene Flow via PDE to Scene Flow via ODE, emphasizing neural Eulerian flow fields in the title, abstract, introduction, and conclusion. This changes the claimed mathematical foundation; the state-of-the-art performance, cross-domain applicability, and emergent tracking claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 3 and Appendix D explain canonical-frame independence through Eulerian fields and per-query trajectory initialization, and discuss Eulerian versus Lagrangian objectives. The earlier explanation attributing nonlinear expressivity to numerical integration is dropped. Interpretations of experimental results and limitations concerning sparsity, computation, and occlusion shadows remain.

D1.justification: Appendix C largely relocates existing implementation details, but v3 omits v1's Adam optimizer, learning rate of 8e-5, 1000 epochs, five-frame minibatches, and explicit adoption of NSFP's early-stopping schedule. Architecture details, preprocessing, hardware/runtime information, and resource links are retained.

R1.justification: The reference list is unchanged. Section 3 recasts the comparison with canonical-frame deformation methods in Eulerian/Lagrangian terms and removes v1's specific contrast between direct nonlinear warp regression and expressivity supplied by numerical integration, producing a limited positioning change.

P1.justification: Sections 3–4 are substantially rewritten to explain Eulerian fields, trajectory extraction, and optimization. The paper is retitled, PDE terminology is replaced throughout, implementation material moves to Appendix C, and Appendix D supplies a structured derivation. The central methodological narrative is extensively revised.

P2.justification: v3 adds the Eulerian/Lagrangian schematic in Figure 4, updates framework labels and captions, and resizes or repositions existing figures as the text reflows. The original experimental plots and qualitative images are retained, with subsequent figures renumbered.

improvement.justification: The revised Sections 3–4 and Appendix D correct the central PDE characterization and make the Eulerian model and trajectory construction clearer, providing a limited net improvement. This gain is tempered by removal of the optimizer recipe and inconsistent Euler-summation indices in Equations 14, 16, and 17 relative to Equation 13. The empirical evidence is unchanged.
